description: Energy system model results for paper: "Interannual weather variability reshapes Europe's cost-optimal hydrogen supply strategy is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Philipp Dunkel, Theresa Klütz (Forschungszentrum Jülich). Solved energy system model instances (netCDF-4, written by FINE) that the figures of the paper "Interannual weather variability reshapes Europe's cost-optimal hydrogen supply strategy" and of the supplement are built from. See README.md in the dataset for the folder structure, the file names, and the figure that uses each file. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
